verdict.rationale: The MCP server docs list a separate sandbox endpoint (https://mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz/mcp) alongside production, and the quickstart offers a Playground for creating test tokens. That gives agents a way to exercise token workflows outside the production endpoint. However, the sandbox appears only as a parenthetical, and nothing explains how it is isolated from production wallets and funds. Missing for 10: documentation of a sandbox REST API base URL, sandbox-specific API keys and test-fund handling, explicit isolation from production data and settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works.
